sentences.en: There's a popular inspirational quote, often attributed to Mahatma Gandhi,
sentences.zh: 有一句广受欢迎的励志名言，通常被认为出自圣雄甘地之口，

sentences.en: that's made its way onto t-shirts, mugs, and posters.
sentences.zh: 它被印在了T恤、马克杯和海报上。

sentences.en: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
It's a noble idea, but the truth is, few of us follow it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个高尚的想法，但事实是，我们很少有人能真正做到。

sentences.en: We put aside our idealism as youthful naivete.
sentences.zh: 我们会把自己的理想主义贬低为少不更事的幼稚。

sentences.en: But what would happen if we didn't do this?
sentences.zh: 但如果我们不这样做，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: If we stood, fully, by our principles?
sentences.zh: 如果我们坚定不移地坚守自己的原则呢？

sentences.en: Julia Butterfly-Hill spent two years in a redwood tree she named Luna
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅·巴特弗莱-希尔在一棵她取名叫“露娜”的红木树上待了两年，

sentences.en: to keep it safe from loggers.
sentences.zh: 以此保护它免受伐木工的砍伐。

sentences.en: To some people, I'm just a dirty tree-hugging hippie.
sentences.zh: 对有些人来说，我只是个肮脏的抱树嬉皮士。

sentences.en: But I just, I can't imagine being able to take a chainsaw to something like this.
sentences.zh: 但我只是……我无法想象自己能拿着链锯对这样的大自然下手。

sentences.en: And then there was Lavoie Finnegan, an Arizona rancher who defied the federal government
sentences.zh: 还有拉沃伊·芬尼根，他是一名亚利桑那州的牧场主，曾公然对抗联邦政府，

sentences.en: and kept grazing his cattle on federal land after he was asked to remove them.
sentences.zh: 在被要求将牛群撤出联邦土地后，他依然坚持在那里放牧。

sentences.en: This fight I make in America, it's not about cows and it's not about grass.
sentences.zh: 我在美国进行的这场抗争，无关乎牛羊，也无关乎青草。

sentences.en: It's about the freedom of our land.
sentences.zh: 它关乎我们土地的自由。

sentences.en: This grazing right is my personal property right.
sentences.zh: 这放牧权是我的个人财产权。

sentences.en: Julia Butterfly-Hill saved the tree after she and her supporters negotiated an agreement
sentences.zh: 朱莉娅·巴特弗莱-希尔在与支持者同木材公司达成协议后，成功挽救了这棵树。

sentences.en: Lavoie Finnegan was killed by Oregon State Police during a standoff on a federal wildlife refuge.
sentences.zh: 拉沃伊·芬尼根在联邦野生动物庇护所的一次对峙中被俄勒冈州警方杀害。

sentences.en: Both said they had no choice but to take their drastic actions.
sentences.zh: 两人都表示，他们别无选择，只能采取激进的行动。

sentences.en: It was a matter of principle.
But the truth is, in daily life, we often veer away from people like this.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，在日常生活中，我们经常会疏远这样的人。
他们可能会让人筋疲力尽，感到刺耳。

sentences.en: They stick to their principles, no matter how small the benefit or how great the coSt.
sentences.zh: 他们坚守原则，无论利益多么微小，代价多么巨大。

sentences.en: This week, we have the story of a couple with ideals that run just as deep.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们为您讲述一对拥有同样坚定理想的夫妇的故事。

sentences.en: A couple who wanted to live their own lives based on what they believed,
sentences.zh: 一对想要根据自己的信仰来过日子的夫妇，

sentences.en: without compromise and without regard for the consequences.
It was far harder than they could have ever imagined.
sentences.zh: 这比他们想象的要艰难得多。

sentences.en: There was a lot of loss involved.
sentences.zh: 其中伴随着巨大的失去。

sentences.en: What it takes to walk the walk, this week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 要如何言行一致，尽在本周的《隐藏的大 脑》。

sentences.en: Our story begins with two young people who decided to start their adult lives with service to the nation.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事从两个决定以投身国家服务开启成年生活的年轻人开始。

sentences.en: In 1994, President Bill Clinton created AmeriCorps.
sentences.zh: 1994年，比尔·克林顿总统创建了“美国国家青年服务队”。

sentences.en: It's a national community service program modeled after the Peace Corps.
sentences.zh: 这是一个仿照和平队建立的国家社区服务项目。

sentences.en: In a swearing-in ceremony on the front steps of the White House,
sentences.zh: 在白宫台阶前举行的宣誓仪式上，

sentences.en: Clinton told the first class of volunteers that they were giving new life to the values that bind Americans.
sentences.zh: 克林顿对第一批志愿者说，他们正在为凝聚美国人的价值观注入新的生命。

sentences.en: But when it is all said and done, it comes down to three simple questions.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，这一切都归结为三个简单的问题。

sentences.en: And what are we going to do about it?
Today, you are doing what is right, turning your words into deeds.
sentences.zh: 今天，你们在做正确的事，将言语转化为行动。

sentences.en: That was the idealistic goal made clear by the oath of service.
sentences.zh: 这就是服务誓词所明确阐述的理想主义目标。

sentences.en: Let me ask all the AmeriCorps volunteers here to raise your hand and repeat after me.
sentences.zh: 请允许我请在场的每一位美国国家青年服务队志愿者举起手来，跟着我念。

sentences.en: I will get things done for America to make our people safer, smarter, and healthier.
sentences.zh: 我将为美国办成实事，让我们的民众更安全、更聪慧、更健康。

sentences.en: In exchange for a small living stipend and help with educational costs,
sentences.zh: 作为获得少量生活津贴和教育费用资助的回报，

sentences.en: AmeriCorps volunteers spend about a year in community service.
sentences.zh: 美国国家青年服务队的志愿者们会花大约一年的时间从事社区服务。

sentences.en: They tutor disadvantaged kids, build homes in poor neighborhoods, provide maintenance in the national parks.
sentences.zh: 他们辅导弱势儿童，在贫困社区建造房屋，在国家公园提供维护保养工作。

sentences.en: Faced with adversity, I will persevere.
sentences.zh: 面对逆境，我将坚持不懈。
我是一名美国国家青年服务队队员。

sentences.en: And I am going to get things done.
And I am going to get things done.
In 1995, Jessica Carnes took the AmeriCorps oath.
sentences.zh: 1995年，杰西卡·卡恩斯宣誓加入了美国国家青年服务队。
罗伊斯·詹姆斯也是如此。

sentences.en: Jessica had recently graduated from high school in New York.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡刚从纽约的高中毕业。
罗伊斯是华盛顿特区人。

sentences.en: They were both assigned to the AmeriCorps campus in Denver.
sentences.zh: 他们都被分配到了丹佛的美国国家青年服务队校园。

sentences.en: The volunteers were housed together in the barracks of an old Air Force base.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们一起住在旧空军基地的营房里。

sentences.en: Jessica says when she first met Royce, she just really liked him.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡说，她第一次见到罗伊斯时，就真的非常喜欢他。

sentences.en: Royce was, Royce is a very handsome man.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯过去是，现在也是一个非常帅气的男人。

sentences.en: And a very loving and charismatic person.
sentences.zh: 而且是一个充满爱心、极具个人魅力的人。

sentences.en: He was a leader in our campus community, getting all of the campus involved in extra service projects beyond what we needed to do.
sentences.zh: 他是我们校园社区的领袖，动员整个校园参与各种超出规定要求的额外服务项目。

sentences.en: Like teaching music to kids at the Boys and Girls Club.
sentences.zh: 比如在男孩女孩俱乐部教孩子们音乐。

sentences.en: Jessica liked that, the way Royce jumped right in.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡很欣赏这一点，欣赏罗伊斯那种二话不说就投入其中的干劲。

sentences.en: When they weren't working, the volunteers hung out together.
sentences.zh: 不工作的时候，志愿者们常聚在一起。

sentences.en: They played a lot of Ultimate Frisbee.

sentences.zh: 他们建立起了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: Eventually, people began pairing up in the way that people do when they are young and broke and helping the world.
sentences.zh: 最终，人们开始像所有年轻、穷困却又心怀世界的人那样，成双成对地恋爱了。

sentences.en: For Jessica and Royce, their connection started with a mishap.
sentences.zh: 对于杰西卡和罗伊斯来说，他们的缘分始于一场小意外。

sentences.en: He hit me in the head with his Frisbee.
sentences.zh: 他的飞盘砸到了我的头。

sentences.en: And then grew during an impromptu road trip with friends to Santa Fe.
sentences.zh: 然后在一场与朋友们即兴前往圣达菲的公路旅行中感情升温。

sentences.en: I just remember starting to look at him a little bit differently.
sentences.zh: 我只记得自己开始用一种稍微不同的眼光看他。

sentences.en: Like, oh, that's a very, very good looking man.
sentences.zh: 心想，哦，那是个非常非常帅的男人。

sentences.en: I already knew he was a really good person and a really fun, good friend.
sentences.zh: 我当时就知道他真的是个很好的人，也是个非常有趣、很好的朋友。

sentences.en: So that's probably where we probably fell in love in the land of enchantment in New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们大概就是在新墨西哥州这片神奇的土地上坠入爱河的吧。

sentences.en: You know, it was a definite, I'm looking at you in a different way and understanding you in a different way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是一种确凿的感觉：我在用不同的眼光看你，在用不同的方式理解你。

sentences.en: I don't know if it was the atmosphere or the weekend or, you know, just the clarity of not pushing so hard.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是因为那种氛围、那个周末，还是因为那种不再强求的清明心境。

sentences.en: And oftentimes I find that's when my heart does the right thing.
sentences.zh: 我常常发现，那就是我的内心做出正确选择的时候。

sentences.en: And I was lucky enough to be able to listen and have that reciprocated.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运能够倾听这种心声，并且得到了回应。

sentences.en: Jessica and Royce decided that once their time with AmeriCorps was over, they'd go to college at New Mexico State.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡和罗伊斯决定，等他们在服务队的时间一结束，就去新墨西哥州立大学上学。

sentences.en: They moved into an adobe apartment with a spiral staircase and a classic New Mexico railing in turquoise.
sentences.zh: 他们搬进了一间带螺旋楼梯和经典绿松石色栏杆的土坯公寓。
他们也深爱着这所大学。

sentences.en: Jessica was getting a double major in women's studies and sociology.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡当时正在攻读妇女研究和社会学的双学士学位。

sentences.en: And I was doing my music, math, minors with my physics major.
sentences.zh: 而我在主修物理学的同时，辅修音乐和数学。

sentences.en: In the clear New Mexico evenings after class, they talk about what they were learning and the ideas and questions they were grappling with.
sentences.zh: 在课后晴朗清新、充满新墨西哥风情的傍晚，他们会谈论所学的新知，探讨那些他们正在苦苦思索的理念和问题。

sentences.en: They thought a lot about social justice, oppression, fairness.
sentences.zh: 他们深入思考了社会正义、压迫和公平。

sentences.en: You know, what does it mean to exist and be a feminist?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，作为一个女权主义者，存在意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does it mean to exist and be an activist?
sentences.zh: 作为一个行动主义者，存在意味着什么？

sentences.en: What does it mean to exist and be a proponent of rights for indigenous people?
sentences.zh: 作为原住民权利的支持者，存在意味着什么？

sentences.en: So, I mean, these were parts of our lives, and we just continued to have these types of conversations.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这些都是我们生活的一部分，我们只是不断地进行这类对话。

sentences.en: Conversations that lots of students have during college when late nights and cheap beer produce passionate arguments.
sentences.zh: 这是许多大学生在深夜伴随着廉价啤酒产生激烈争论时常有的对话。

sentences.en: The thing about Jessica and Royce is that they didn't see these issues as just debate fodder.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡和罗伊斯的不同之处在于，他们并不把这些议题仅仅看作辩论的素材。
这就是他们真实的样子。

sentences.en: Royce, for instance, grew up with family stories of the civil rights movement.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，罗伊斯从小就听过许多关于民权运动的家族故事。

sentences.en: In 1960, his uncle, Franklin McCain, was one of four young black college freshmen who sat down at a whites-only Woolworth lunch counter in Greensboro, North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 1960年，他的叔叔富兰克林·麦凯恩是四名年轻的黑人大学生之一，他们在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒市一家只接待白人的伍尔沃思百货公司午餐柜台坐了下来。

sentences.en: Four college freshmen, all Negroes, were refused service at a Greensboro, North Carolina lunch counter, and the civil rights sit-in was born.
sentences.zh: 四名全都是黑人的大学新生在北卡罗来纳州格林斯伯勒市的一个午餐柜台遭到拒绝服务，民权静坐抗议运动由此诞生。

sentences.en: Over the coming days, the lunch counter protests grew and spread.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几天里，午餐柜台抗议活动不断发展并蔓延开来。

sentences.en: More than 1,500 Negroes were jailed over a period of several days, most of them students from the North Carolina Agricultural and Technical Institute and from Bennett College.
sentences.zh: 在短短几天内，有1500多名黑人被捕，其中大部分是来自北卡罗来纳州农工学院和贝内特学院的学生。

sentences.en: Mr. Farmer said the entire Negro population, 40,000, stood ready to go to jail.
sentences.zh: 弗莫尔先生表示，整个黑人群体，共计4万人，随时准备入狱。

sentences.en: The protests eventually led to the desegregation of lunch counters across the South, a major victory in the civil rights movement.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动最终促成了美国南方各地午餐柜台的废除种族隔离，这是民权运动中的一次重大胜利。

sentences.en: Years later, Franklin McCain talked about his role as one of the Greensboro Four, as the young men came to be known.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，富兰克林·麦凯恩谈到了自己作为后来被称为“格林斯伯勒四人组”成员之一的经历。

sentences.en: He said he acted because it was time to take a stand.
sentences.zh: 他说他之所以行动，是因为是时候表明立场了。

sentences.en: If there is something that you want to do, and in your heart, you know that it needs to be changed, modified, or turned upside down, go ahead and do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你有想做的事，并且在内心深处，你知道它需要被改变、被修正或被彻底颠覆，那就去做吧。
罗伊斯欣然接受了叔叔的建议。

sentences.en: It's one reason he pays such close attention to injustice and inequality.
sentences.zh: 这也是他如此密切关注不公正和不平等现象的原因之一。

sentences.en: And he feels it in his own life.
sentences.zh: 而且他在自己的生活中也真切地感受到了这一点。

sentences.en: When he and Jessica sit down to eat at a restaurant today, as an interracial couple, they still experience remnants of prejudice from long ago.
sentences.zh: 如今，当他和杰西卡作为跨种族情侣一起去餐厅吃饭时，他们依然会经历长久以来残存的偏见。

sentences.en: There's often times where the server will kind of look at both of us and really not know what to do, because they don't know, wait,
sentences.zh: 经常会发生这样的情况：服务员会打量我们俩，然后真的不知道该怎么办，因为他们不知道，等等，

sentences.en: there's a white woman there and a black man.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个白人女性和一个黑人男性。

sentences.en: Who do I give the check to?
Jessica and Royce strongly felt that they wanted to live honest, open lives, unencumbered by systems of bias and oppression.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡和罗伊斯强烈地感觉到，他们想要过一种诚实、公开的生活，不受偏见和压迫系统的束缚。

sentences.en: The more they talked, the more they were sure it was the right way to live.
sentences.zh: 他们谈得越多，就越确信这是正确的生活方式。

sentences.en: At school, Jessica came across an idea so powerful, she couldn't stop thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 在学校里，杰西卡接触到一个如此震撼的理念，让她挥之不去。

sentences.en: For her undergraduate degree in women's studies, she began a research paper.
sentences.zh: 为了完成妇女研究专业的本科学位，她开始撰写一篇研究论文。
关于学前教育中的性别分层。

sentences.en: And that was when I first recognized and started looking at the things that adults project onto children from birth
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我第一次认识到并开始审视成年人从出生起就强加给儿童的种种观念，

sentences.en: that affects the way that children move through and experience the world.
sentences.zh: 这些观念影响了孩子们融入和体验世界的方式。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Jessica began seeing how gender shapes all kinds of choices.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，杰西卡开始看出性别是如何塑造各种各样选择的。

sentences.en: I remember working at the Boys and Girls Club near our college and seeing the children watching how they played
sentences.zh: 我记得在离我们大学不远的男孩女孩俱乐部工作时，看到孩子们玩耍，观察他们的游戏方式，

sentences.en: and how they were able to play based on what they were wearing
sentences.zh: 以及他们穿着的服装如何限制了他们的玩耍方式，

sentences.en: and thinking those girls could also be up at the top of that playscape swinging upside down
sentences.zh: 然后心想，如果那些女孩们没有穿着凉鞋和夏日连衣裙，

sentences.en: if they weren't wearing sandals and sundresses.
sentences.zh: 她们其实也可以爬上那个游乐设施的顶端倒挂着荡秋千。

sentences.en: A little earlier, Jessica had come to a similar insight about her own life.
sentences.zh: 稍早前，杰西卡对自己的生活也有了类似的深刻体悟。

sentences.en: Like a lot of women, Jessica had always thought she was bad at math.
sentences.zh: 和许多女性一样，杰西卡一直以为自己数学不好。

sentences.en: Before starting college, she had to take remedial algebra.
sentences.zh: 在开始上大学前，她不得不修读补习代数。
她预料自己会考得很差。

sentences.en: One night, as she struggled with a problem, she asked Royce for help.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，当她为一道题苦苦思索时，她向罗伊斯求助。

sentences.en: I just remember I was writing a song at the time with my guitar and I turned the paper over and said,
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时我正拿着吉他写一首歌，我把纸翻过来对他说，

sentences.en: well, just read it to me like it says.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那就照着它上面写的读给我听。

sentences.en: And I worked it out and I said, okay, well, let's go through it piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 然后我把它解开了，我说，好吧，那我们一块儿逐个步骤来看看。

sentences.en: And she just needed the little confidence booSt.
sentences.zh: 她当时只是需要一点点自信心的鼓励。

sentences.en: Some confidence, someone who expected she could do it, who didn't let her off the hook.
sentences.zh: 一些自信，一个相信她能够做到、不肯轻易放过她的人。

sentences.en: Jessica began to wonder why, as a child, her teachers hadn't done the same thing,
sentences.zh: 杰西卡开始纳闷，为什么当她还是个孩子的时候，她的老师们没有这样做，

sentences.en: expected that she could be good at math.
sentences.zh: 没有去期望她其实也可以擅长数学。

sentences.en: And looking back, and this is just me kind of, when I was at this point in college
sentences.zh: 回想起来——这只是我当时在大学里的某种感悟

sentences.en: and learning these new things, looking back on that experience of math,
sentences.zh: 而学习这些新事物，回想起那段数学经历，

sentences.en: early math, doing a long division problem and thinking,
sentences.zh: 早期的数学，做一道长除法题然后想着，

sentences.en: maybe the teacher wasn't surprised that I couldn't solve that problem because I was a girl.
sentences.zh: 也许老师对我解不出那道题并不感到意外，因为我是个女孩。

sentences.en: Her newly sown confidence made a difference in that remedial algebra class.
sentences.zh: 她新萌生的自信在那堂补习代数课上发挥了作用。

sentences.en: And I was so amazed, and it changed the course of my experience and what I thought that I could
sentences.zh: 我感到非常震惊，它改变了我的人生轨迹，也改变了我认为自己
甚至能在大学里选修什么的看法。

sentences.en: Jessica added this experience to her mental catalog of biases.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡将这段经历加入了她心中的偏见目录。

sentences.en: Gender, like race, is an accident of birth.
sentences.zh: 性别就像种族一样，是出生时偶然决定的。

sentences.en: So why does it define so much of what we can and cannot do?
sentences.zh: 那为什么它决定了我们能做什么、不能做什么的那么多方面？

sentences.en: She and Royce began to mull over gender issues in their evening conversations.
sentences.zh: 她和罗伊斯开始在晚上的谈话中琢磨性别问题。

sentences.en: They felt they were opening their eyes to rules about how boys and girls are supposed to behave,
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己开始看清关于男孩和女孩应该如何行事的种种规则，

sentences.en: rules so ingrained that people don't notice them anymore.
sentences.zh: 这些规则根深蒂固，人们甚至不再注意它们。

sentences.en: These are the things that we're just steeped in, in the world.
sentences.zh: 这些就是我们在这个世界上深陷其中的事物。

sentences.en: I don't think we're encouraged to take a minute and think about how we decide to dress our babies,
sentences.zh: 我想我们不会被鼓励花点时间去思考我们是如何决定给婴儿穿什么衣服的，

sentences.en: how we choose the favorite color for our babies depending on what their sex is.
sentences.zh: 我们是如何根据婴儿的性别为他们选择最喜欢的颜色的。

sentences.en: Or when you say that you're expecting and somebody says, what is it?
sentences.zh: 或者当你宣布你怀孕了，然后有人问，是个男孩还是女孩？

sentences.en: You know, and you don't answer with, well, it's a human.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你不会回答说，嗯，是个小人类。

sentences.en: You know, you're expected to answer with a particular, it's a boy or it's a girl.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大家期望你给出特定的回答，是个男孩或是个女孩。

sentences.en: And Jessica believes that label, boy or girl,
sentences.zh: 杰西卡坚信，男孩或女孩这个标签，

sentences.en: shapes the whole experience of how the family and the community responds to the pregnancy
sentences.zh: 塑造了家庭和社区对怀孕、

sentences.en: and the birth and the preparations.
sentences.zh: 出生以及筹备工作做出反应的整个经历。

sentences.en: And so even just sitting with that, oh my goodness, those are actual,
sentences.zh: 因此，仅仅是坐下来体会这一点，天哪，那些其实是，

sentences.en: those are maybe unconscious choices, but they are actually choices.
sentences.zh: 那些也许是无意识的选择，但它们确实是选择。

sentences.en: The young couple weren't planning on becoming parents anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 这对年轻夫妇并没有近期当父母的计划。

sentences.en: In fact, after graduating from college, they headed to different cities.
sentences.zh: 事实上，大学毕业后，他们去了不同的城市。

sentences.en: Royce was off to New London, Connecticut to office her candidate school for the Coast Guard.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯动身前往康涅狄格州新伦敦，去海岸警卫队候官学校报到。

sentences.en: Jessica took a job in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡在华盛顿特区找了一份工作，

sentences.en: as a statistician with the Census Bureau,
sentences.zh: 在人口普查局担任统计员，
这要归功于她在数学上取得的成功。

sentences.en: She also made plans to start graduate school.
sentences.zh: 她还计划开始读研究生。

sentences.en: They saw each other when they could.
sentences.zh: 他们只要有机会就会见面。

sentences.en: Sometimes she'd go north to him, sometimes he'd come south to her.
sentences.zh: 有时她去北方找他，有时他去南方找她。

sentences.en: It was after one of those visits that Jessica discovered she was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 正是在其中一次探访之后，杰西卡发现自己怀孕了。

sentences.en: Royce was back in New London, and as a young officer candidate,
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯当时在由于新伦敦，作为一名年轻的候官，

sentences.en: I had to send him a letter.
I got a letter, a FedEx letter, that told me that we were pregnant.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封信，一封联邦快递的信，告诉我我们怀孕了。

sentences.en: Royce got a land-based assignment with the Coast Guard.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯在海岸警卫队获得了一份陆上工作。

sentences.en: Jessica put grad school on hold.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡把读研的事搁置了。

sentences.en: They started preparing for the baby.
sentences.zh: 他们开始为孩子做准备。

sentences.en: Jessica wanted to have a pregnancy with minimal medical intervention,
sentences.zh: 杰西卡希望经历一次医疗干预最少的怀孕，
但有一个例外，那就是B超。

sentences.en: And that's how she learned she was carrying a girl.
sentences.zh: 也就是这样，她得知自己怀了个女孩。

sentences.en: Suddenly, all those things about gender she'd made a mental note of,
sentences.zh: 突然间，她记下的所有关于性别的事情，

sentences.en: I started thinking about how I wanted to shape things a little bit differently

sentences.zh: 我想要如何把事情做得略有不同。

sentences.en: Jessica didn't want her daughter to be lumped into a category.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡不想让她的女儿被归入某个范畴。

sentences.en: She didn't want a baby in pink.
sentences.zh: 她不想要一身粉红的婴儿。

sentences.en: I'd really like to give her a chance to figure out what even her favorite color is
sentences.zh: 我真的很想给她一个机会去弄清楚她自己最喜欢的颜色是什么，

sentences.en: and figure out who she is as a person
sentences.zh: 弄清楚她作为一个人是谁，

sentences.en: and not as an idea about what other people think she should be.
sentences.zh: 而不是根据别人认为她应该成为什么的观点去定义。

sentences.en: What Jessica wanted was to raise her daughter free from gender stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡想要的是抚养女儿摆脱性别刻板印象。

sentences.en: It's an idea that others have pondered for many decades.
sentences.zh: 这个想法其他人已经琢磨了几十年。

sentences.en: Back in the early 1970s, for instance,
the author Lois Gould wrote a fictional account for Ms. Magazine
sentences.zh: 作家路易斯·古尔德在《女士》杂志上写了一篇虚构小说，

sentences.en: about a couple trying to raise a genderless child.
sentences.zh: 讲述了一对试图抚养一个无性别儿童的夫妇。

sentences.en: The story of X created a sensation.
It was eventually turned into a book,
sentences.zh: 它最终被改编成了一本书，

sentences.en: and in 2016, an animated short film.
sentences.zh: 并在2016年被改编成了一部动画短片。

sentences.en: Once upon a time, a baby named X was born.
sentences.zh: 从前，诞生了一个名叫X的婴儿。

sentences.en: This baby was named X because no one could tell whether it was a boy or a girl.
sentences.zh: 这个婴儿被命名为X，因为没有人能看出它是男孩还是女孩。

sentences.en: Its parents could tell, of course, but they couldn't tell anyone else.
sentences.zh: 当然，它的父母能看出来，但他们不能告诉任何人。

sentences.en: You see, it was all part of a very important secret scientific experiment
sentences.zh: 你看，这一切都是一个非常重要的秘密科学实验的一部分，

sentences.en: known officially as Project Baby X.
In the story, X's parents keep hitting barriers
sentences.zh: 在故事中，X的父母在试图在不透露性别的情况下抚养孩子时，

sentences.en: as they try to raise the child without revealing its gender.
Friends and family are furious that they aren't told what the baby is.
sentences.zh: 朋友和家人对没有被告知这孩子是什么性别感到愤怒。

sentences.en: On his first shopping trip, Mr. Jones told the store clerk,
sentences.zh: 在第一次购物时，琼斯先生对店员说，

sentences.en: I need some clothes and toys for my new baby.
sentences.zh: 我需要为我的新宝宝买些衣服和玩具。

sentences.en: Well, now, is it a boy or a girl?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么，这是个男孩还是女孩？

sentences.en: But the clerk got all red in the face and said huffily.
sentences.zh: 但店员涨红了脸，气呼呼地说道。

sentences.en: Well, in that case, I'm afraid I can't help you, sir.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那样的话，恐怕我帮不了你，先生。

sentences.en: The point of the baby X tale is to highlight all the ways gender stereotypes
sentences.zh: X宝宝故事的重点在于突显性别刻板印象作为儿童规则的所有方式，
从他们穿的衣服，到他们玩的运动，

sentences.en: from the clothes they wear, to the sports they play,
sentences.zh: 再到他们被鼓励去追求的兴趣。

sentences.en: to the interests they're encouraged to pursue.
sentences.zh: 再到他们被鼓励去追求的兴趣。

sentences.en: Now, Royce and Jessica weren't trying to hide that daughter's gender.
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯和杰西卡并不是想隐藏他们女儿的性别。

sentences.en: They just wanted her to grow up without all the stereotypes attached to being a girl.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想让她长大后，身上没有附带作为女孩的种种刻板印象。

sentences.en: Jessica devoured articles on gender and parenting.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡如饥似渴地阅读关于性别和育儿的文章。

sentences.en: So did Royce, reading late into the night,
sentences.zh: 罗伊斯也是如此，深夜还在阅读，

sentences.en: under his bed covers, by flashlight.
They didn't label their evolving child-rearing philosophy,
sentences.zh: 他们没有给他们不断演变的育儿理念贴标签，

sentences.en: but these days, we'd call it gender-neutral parenting.
sentences.zh: 但如今，我们会称之为中性育儿。

sentences.en: They had strong views on what would and wouldn't be good for their daughter.
sentences.zh: 对于什么对女儿有益、什么无益，他们有坚定的看法。

sentences.en: We had started talking about, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们开始讨论，你知道的，

sentences.en: we're not going to be getting her baby dolls and Barbies,
sentences.zh: 我们不打算给她买婴儿娃娃和芭比娃娃，

sentences.en: and we want her to have open-ended, free-play toys.
sentences.zh: 我们希望她拥有开放式的、自由玩耍的玩具。

sentences.en: And wanted toys that had animals and lots of bright colors instead of,
sentences.zh: 并希望玩具带有动物和许多明亮的颜色，而不是，

sentences.en: bright primary colors instead of just pastel pink and princess or fairy.
sentences.zh: 明亮的原色，而不是只有粉红色调以及公主或仙女。

sentences.en: And so they planned and waited.
sentences.zh: 于是他们规划着、等待着。

sentences.en: They decided on a name, Isis,
sentences.zh: 他们决定起个名字叫伊西斯，

sentences.en: after the fierce Egyptian goddess and symbol of powerful womanhood.
sentences.zh: 以凶猛的埃及女神和强大女性气质的象征命名。
伊西斯有她自己的计划。

sentences.en: On November 7, 2000, she was born two months premature.
She was rushed to the neonatal intensive care unit, or the NICU.
sentences.zh: 她被紧急送往新生儿重症监护室，简称NICU。

sentences.en: Now, all that Royce and Jessica wanted was for Isis to survive.
sentences.zh: 现在，罗伊斯和杰西卡唯一的愿望就是伊西斯能够存活下来。

sentences.en: When Isis was in the neonatal, she needed to nurse every two hours.
sentences.zh: 当伊西斯在新生儿重症监护室时，她每两个小时需要喂奶一次。

sentences.en: And so we lived a little under a mile away,
sentences.zh: 所以我们住在离这不到一英里的地方，

sentences.en: and so we had to go every two hours,
sentences.zh: 因此我们每两个小时就得去一次，

sentences.en: which means that the feeding took a good, you know,
sentences.zh: 这意味着喂奶需要花上好一阵子，你知道的，

sentences.en: And so we would, and then we would go home, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我们会，然后我们会回家，你知道的，

sentences.en: catch 20 minutes, 30 minutes of sleep, get back up, and go right back.
sentences.zh: 抓紧时间睡上20分钟、30分钟，再爬起来，马上又回去。

sentences.en: And in this atmosphere of breathing machines and monitors,
sentences.zh: 在这种充满呼吸机和监护仪的氛围中，

sentences.en: Jessica had her first big encounter with gender stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡迎来了她与性别刻板印象的第一次重大冲突。

sentences.en: At one point, the nurses were concerned about both Isis and Jessica,
sentences.zh: 有一次，护士们对伊西斯和杰西卡都有些担心，

sentences.en: They said, you know what, I think you and the baby are stressed out,
sentences.zh: 她们说，你知道吗，我觉得你和宝宝都压力太大了，

sentences.en: and I think that why don't you let us give her a bottle,
sentences.zh: 我想，为什么不让我们给她喂奶瓶，

sentences.en: and you go home and take a nap.
And we lived about a mile or so from the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我们住的地方离医院大约一英里左右。

sentences.en: So I left my baby, and I think we probably had her like in yellow and green, maybe.
sentences.zh: 所以我离开了我的宝宝，我想我们当时可能给她穿着黄绿色之类的衣服。

sentences.en: I wasn't trying to dress her like a boy.
sentences.zh: 我并不是想把她打扮得像个男孩。

sentences.en: You know, I just wanted to have what I consider to be neutral colors.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我只是想穿我认为是中性颜色的衣服。

sentences.en: Had her in just some, a regular sleeper.
sentences.zh: 只给她穿了一些普通的连体衣。

sentences.en: And I came back to find the little box that my little baby was in
sentences.zh: 当我回来时，发现我小宝宝呆的小箱子

sentences.en: was shrouded in pink and lace and fluff.
sentences.zh: 被粉红色、蕾丝和绒毛包裹着。

sentences.en: And inside, my little baby had ribbons in her hair.
sentences.zh: 里面，我的小宝宝头发上扎着丝带。

sentences.en: I don't even know how this is possible.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道这怎么可能。

sentences.en: Had been like dunked in a Pepto-Bismol bottle in pink, everything.
sentences.zh: 就像是在一瓶汰百安粉色止泻药里浸泡过一样，全都是粉的。

sentences.en: And the nurses were so excited to see how I was going to react
sentences.zh: 护士们非常兴奋地想看看我会有什么反应，

sentences.en: that they had done this nice thing for me while I was at home resting.
sentences.zh: 因为她们在我回家休息时为我做了这件好事。

sentences.en: And I was, I was horrified.
Now Jessica's reaction might seem extreme.
sentences.zh: 现在杰西卡的反应可能看起来有些极端。

sentences.en: It was a gesture of kindness, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟这是一种善意的举动。

sentences.en: And Isis was just a newborn.
sentences.zh: 而且伊西斯只是个新生儿。

sentences.en: That's not how Jessica sees it.
I was instantly validated in my anger by somebody who was visiting another baby nearby
sentences.zh: 我的愤怒立刻得到了验证，当时旁边正探望另一个婴儿的人

sentences.en: who turned and looked at my baby in my arms, my little pink baby doll,
sentences.zh: 转过身看着我怀里的宝宝，我那个粉红色的充气娃娃似的小宝宝，

sentences.en: and said, oh, she's so precious and delicate and dainty.
sentences.zh: 说道，噢，她真是太可爱、太娇小、太精致了。

sentences.en: We're in the NICU and we want to go home.
sentences.zh: 我们在新生儿重症监护室，我们想回家。

sentences.en: And we're not going for precious and dainty and delicate.
sentences.zh: 我们不求什么娇小、文静、娇嫩。

sentences.en: We're going for strong and powerful and healthy.
sentences.zh: 我们要的是坚强、有力量、健康。
语言对杰西卡来说很重要。

sentences.en: I noticed that from that moment, how other people would talk to her.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，我注意到其他人会如何与她对话。

sentences.en: And I felt words are powerful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得话语具有强大的力量。

sentences.en: And right now we're, we want all of our energy to be towards growth and strength and power.
sentences.zh: 现在我们，我们希望把所有的精力都投入到成长、力量和能量上。

sentences.en: What Jessica was realizing is something marketers have long understood.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡所意识到的是营销人员早已明白的道理。
语言传递出强烈的信号。

sentences.en: We pulled some toy ads from the early 2000s when Isis was a baby.
sentences.zh: 我们找了一些2000年代初艾西斯还是婴儿时的玩具广告。

sentences.en: And what we heard over and over were two distinct tones, one for boys and one for girls.
sentences.zh: 我们一遍又一遍听到的是两种截然不同的语调，一种针对男孩，一种针对女孩。

sentences.en: Hush, little baby, I love you, cause you do the best real babies, do you?
sentences.zh: 嘘，小宝贝，我爱你，因为你表现得像个真正的宝贝，对吗？

sentences.en: Hush, little baby, looks and sounds so real, you'll think she's a real baby.
sentences.zh: 嘘，小宝贝，外表和声音都如此真实，你会以为她是个真正的婴儿。

sentences.en: To Jessica, messages like these were about much more than dolls and tea parties.
sentences.zh: 对杰西卡来说，这些信息远不止关乎洋娃娃和茶话会。

sentences.en: The clothes Isis wore, even as a preemie in the NICU,
sentences.zh: 艾西斯穿的衣服，哪怕是在新生儿重症监护室里的早产儿时期，

sentences.en: changed the way the world behaved toward her.
sentences.zh: 也改变了世界对待她的方式。

sentences.en: When my baby is in what people consider to be boys' clothes, yellow,
sentences.zh: 当我的宝宝穿著被人们认为是男孩衣服的黄色衣服时，

sentences.en: they would say, oh, look at that strong baby.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，哦，看那个强壮的宝宝。

sentences.en: You know, you are doing great.
You're growing so big and so faSt.
And when she was in that pink outfit, all of a sudden she was dainty and delicate.
sentences.zh: 而当她穿上那套粉色衣服时，她突然间就变得娇小而脆弱了。

sentences.en: Here was all the stuff that she'd read about made real.
sentences.zh: 她以前读过的那些东西现在都变成现实了。

sentences.en: It galvanized Jessica to walk the walk and not just talk the talk,
sentences.zh: 这激励着杰西卡付诸行动，而不仅仅是嘴上说说，

sentences.en: to be the change she wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 去成为她想看到的改变。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what I want.
Not just now, not just getting strong enough to go home and leave the hospital and be healthy.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是现在，不仅仅是变得足够强壮以回家离开医院并保持健康。

sentences.en: This is what I want for her for her whole life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我希望她一辈子都拥有的。

sentences.en: I want her to feel like she is strong and powerful.
sentences.zh: 我希望她觉得自己坚强而有力。

sentences.en: Jessica and Royce thought if they could just make it past the NICU,
sentences.zh: 杰西卡和罗伊斯以为，只要他们能熬过新生儿重症监护室的阶段，

sentences.en: the hardest part would be over.
sentences.zh: 最艰难的部分就结束了。

sentences.en: When Jessica and Royce, a young interracial couple,
sentences.zh: 当年轻的跨种族夫妇杰西卡和罗伊斯

sentences.en: found out they were having a daughter,
sentences.zh: 得知他们将迎来一个女儿时，

sentences.en: they decided to raise her free of gender stereotypes.
sentences.zh: 他们决定在抚养她时不带任何性别刻板印象。

sentences.en: It was an idealistic goal that turned out to be far more complicated than they imagined.
sentences.zh: 这是一个理想主义的目标，结果却比他们想象的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Their daughter, Isis, was born early
sentences.zh: 他们的女儿艾西斯早产，

sentences.en: and spent the first two weeks of her life in the neonatal intensive care unit.
sentences.zh: 在新生儿重症监护室度过了生命的头两周。

sentences.en: When Royce and Jessica left the hospital,
sentences.zh: 当罗伊斯和杰西卡离开医院时，

sentences.en: they thought that things would get easier.
sentences.zh: 他们以为事情会变得容易些。

sentences.en: But they quickly found that their choices for their own family set people spinning.
sentences.zh: 但他们很快发现，他们为自己家庭做出的选择让周围的人大跌眼镜。

sentences.en: Here was Royce, a black man in a Coast Guard uniform,
